incidents.name: BigBangSwap sellRewardToken fixed-rate buyback
incidents.notes: The BigBangSwap proxy's sellRewardToken() buys BGG back for BUSD at a rate that ignores the market price, so the attacker bought BGG cheaply on PancakeSwap inside a DODO flash loan and sold it straight back to the proxy.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xa45d4359246dbd523ab690bef01da06b07450030 created 2023-10-19T06:24:04Z by 0x60191e2b43cbe002d58d693f57acd0060e4276c2, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc1b6f9898576d722dbf604aaa452cfea3a639c59; 15 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from last of 15 upgrade events (onchain).
